title: 第十九章 瞬杀强敌第二十章 初赛收官晋级八强
slug: 震惊五星灵帝被逼着撩妹
lines: 赵冲的拳头裹挟着雷电之势，朝杨卤的面门狠狠砸去！
这一拳快到了极致，拳风甚至在空中拉出一道淡蓝色的雷弧轨迹，连擂台边缘的防御符文都受到了冲击，发出嗡嗡的震颤声。
围观弟子们只觉得眼前一花，赵冲的拳头已经贴近了杨卤的鼻尖，距离不过三寸！
“好快！”
“这一拳绝对能秒杀！”
“杨卤完了！”
无数人心中闪过这个念头。
但就在这一瞬间，杨卤动了。
他没有后退，没有闪避，甚至连防御姿势都没有摆出来。他只是微微侧头——
赵冲的拳头贴着他的耳郭擦过，带起的拳风把他额前的碎发吹得向后飞扬。
没中。
全场寂静。
赵冲瞳孔一缩，心中猛地一惊。他这一拳已经是他最快的速度了，就算是同阶的二星灵王大圆满也难以躲开，可杨卤却像是提前知道他的攻击路线一样，轻轻松松就躲了过去！
但赵冲毕竟是内门前三的天才，反应极快。一拳落空，他立刻变招，右拳回收，左拳顺势横扫而出！
“崩雷二段！”
左手拳头带着更猛烈的雷光，横砸杨卤的太阳穴！
这一击角度刁钻，速度比第一拳还要快上三分！
可杨卤依然不慌不忙，只是身体微微后仰，让赵冲的拳头再次从他面前掠过。
还是没中。
赵冲心中开始慌了。
他咬紧牙关，双拳齐出，连环猛攻！惊雷崩拳的招式在他手中发挥到了极致，一拳接着一拳，快如闪电，密如暴雨！拳影几乎笼罩了杨卤全身的每一个要害！
但杨卤就像是一棵随风摇曳的柳树，在密集的拳影中从容穿梭。他的身法轻盈到了极致，每一次躲闪的幅度都不大，但每一次都精准地避开了赵冲的攻击。
十息过去了。
二十息过去了。
三十息过去了。
赵冲已经打出了上百拳，但连杨卤的衣角都没碰到！
他的呼吸开始变得急促，额头上渗出细密的汗珠，拳头的力道也不如一开始那么猛了。
“这……这怎么可能？”赵冲心中翻起惊涛骇浪，“我的速度已经快到极限了，他怎么还能躲开？”
围观的弟子们也全都看傻了。
“赵师兄打了这么多拳，一下都没打中？”
“这躲闪能力……也太离谱了吧？”
“难道他的身法比赵师兄的拳头还快？”
“不可能！赵师兄的惊雷崩拳可是以速度著称的！二星灵王中根本没人能躲得开！”
“那现在这是什么情况？”
擂台上，赵冲越打越急，越急越乱。他的拳法已经开始变形，动作也不像一开始那么流畅了。
就在这时，杨卤突然开口了。
“打完了？”
他声音很轻，带着一丝漫不经心的调侃。
赵冲心头一跳，还没来得及回应，就感觉眼前一花——
杨卤的右手已经伸到了他面前，五指微微张开，掌心朝外。
content_en:
Zhao Chong's fist was packed with thunder and lightning and hit Yang Lu hard in the face!
This punch was so fast that it even pulled out a light blue lightning arc in the air. Even the defensive runes on the edge of the ring were impacted and made a buzzing trembling sound.
The surrounding disciples felt their eyes dazzled as Zhao Chong's fist was already close to the tip of Yang Lu's nose, and the distance was only three inches!
"So fast!"
"This punch can definitely kill you instantly!"
"Yang Lu is finished!"
This thought flashed through the minds of countless people.
But at this moment, Yang Lu moved.
He didn't retreat, didn't dodge, and didn't even assume a defensive posture. He just tilted his head slightly——
Zhao Chong's fist brushed against his ear, and the wind from the fist blew the strands of hair from his forehead flying back.
Missed.
There was silence.
Zhao Chong's pupils shrank and he was suddenly startled. His punch was already his fastest. Even the two-star spiritual king Dzogchen of the same level could not avoid it, but Yang Lu seemed to know his attack route in advance and easily dodged it!
But Zhao Chong is, after all, one of the top three geniuses in the inner sect, and his reactions are extremely quick. When the punch failed, he immediately changed his moves, retracted his right fist, and swept out with his left fist!
"Second stage of Thunder Collapse!"
The left fist struck Yang Lu's temple with an even more violent lightning!
The angle of this strike was tricky, and the speed was three points faster than the first punch!
But Yang Lu remained unhurried, just leaning back slightly, allowing Zhao Chong's fist to pass by him again.
Still missed.
Zhao Chong began to panic.
He gritted his teeth, punched out with both fists, and launched a series of fierce attacks! The Thunder Collapse Fist technique was used to its extreme in his hands, one punch after another, as fast as lightning and as dense as a heavy rain! The shadow of the fist covered almost every vital part of Yang Lu's body!
But Yang Lu was like a willow tree swaying in the wind, moving calmly among the dense shadows of fists. His movement was extremely light, and the range of each dodge was not large, but he accurately avoided Zhao Chong's attacks every time.
Ten breaths passed.
Twenty breaths have passed.
Thirty breaths have passed.
Zhao Chong had already punched hundreds of times, but he didn't even touch the corner of Yang Lu's clothes!
His breathing began to become rapid, beads of sweat appeared on his forehead, and the force of his fists was not as strong as it was at the beginning.
"This... how is this possible?" Zhao Chong's heart was filled with turmoil, "My speed has reached the limit, how can he still avoid it?"
The disciples who were watching were all dumbfounded.
"Senior Brother Zhao punched so many times and didn't even hit a single hit?"
"This dodge ability... is too outrageous, right?"
"Is his movement faster than Senior Brother Zhao's fist?"
"Impossible! Senior Brother Zhao's Thunder Collapse Fist is famous for its speed! No one among the two-star spirit kings can dodge it!"
"So what's going on now?"
In the ring, Zhao Chong became more and more anxious as he fought, becoming more and more chaotic. His boxing techniques have begun to deform, and his movements are not as smooth as they were at the beginning.
At this moment, Yang Lu suddenly spoke.
"Finished?"
His voice was very soft, with a hint of casual teasing.
Zhao Chong's heart skipped a beat, and before he could respond, he felt his eyes flashing——
Yang Lu's right hand had been stretched out in front of him, with the fingers slightly spread and the palm facing outward.
